capabilities: Shift ordered list marker style with each indent level in read mode
Apply default styles including decimal, lower-alpha, lower-roman, upper-alpha, upper-roman and bullet styles
Plan customizable list styles via a settings page
disambiguation: Only affects ordered lists' numbering styles in read mode; unordered lists and edit mode are untouched.
extras: Author will keep publishing security updates but recommends switching to the Lawlist plugin; the planned settings page for custom list styles is not implemented yet.
problem: Obsidian renders every nested ordered list level with the same marker, so deep ordered lists are hard to read.

relations.evidence: This plugin is being deprecated in favor of Lawlist by Willem Schlieter.

summary: Read-mode styling plugin that changes ordered list numbering styles per indentation level (decimal, alpha, roman, etc.).
